page_states.notes: Native Win32 dialog can appear before Vehicle Selection banner text is populated.

signals.text_contains: Vehicle data is loaded from session

page_states.notes: Green banner state: vehicle data is loaded and Enter should continue.
Yellow banner state, normally transient; long duration should be handled by policy.
Red banner or no-device-selected state; select VCI Proxy (Remote) before continuing.
Deep page loading can hang; do not press Back repeatedly.
Prefer clickable Navigation Path common ancestor, then Back/Home fallback.
Disconnect page can be transient or require OK/backtrack recovery.

recovery_policies.notes: Select the default proxy VCI and continue into Vehicle Selection.
When the session-loaded green banner is visible, Enter is the correct next action.
Wait for connecting state to become connected or disconnected before acting.
If loading persists, restart GDS2 and resume the original registry task.
Recover from wrong module/branch by going to nearest common ancestor.
Mirrors existing data display connection recovery policy.
